correctness.rationale: The eight Boolean equations exhaust all quantifier-free atomic diagrams of two chosen elements with named 0, since R is ternary rather than a function. The exact two-round Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé type is the set of pointed one-step extension-type sets, not its multiplicities. For fixed first element x, exceptional y lie in {0,x,-x,2x} union 2-torsion and halves of x, at most eight positions. Generic choices occur uniformly for n>=9 and separately n=7. The remaining coincidences are controlled by order of x truncated at 1,2,3,4,>=5, whether x is a double, and divisibility of n by 2,3,4,8, exactly gcd(n,24). Seven explicit rank-two sentences separate the seven small exceptions and the eight stabilized classes. For sharpness every cyclic order in the class gcd=24 is a multiple of 24. Independently reconstructed complete reduced atomic diagrams through n=128 and raw relational formulas on small n; all 15 classes and listed minimum representatives checked; this finite check corroborates the uniform lemma.
